google_play.recommended_app_screenshot_set: At least four 1080 x 1920 portrait or 1920 x 1080 landscape captures for relevant recommendation surfaces.
google_play.screenshot_tagline_guidance: Keep additional tagline text to no more than 20% of the image; prioritize actual UI.
google_play.personal_account_conditional_production_: For qualifying personal accounts created after 2023-11-13: a closed test with at least 12 testers opted in continuously for 14 days, then application for production access.
google_play.deletion: Apps offering account creation need an in-app route and an accessible external account-deletion request resource.
